load_project_manifest: load a project manifest by name or path using the load_project function with build options
load_all_manifests: load all available project manifests from the manifests directory using the load_all_manifests function
manifest_loader_dependency_order: compute topologically sorted dependency order for all loaded manifests using ManifestLoader manifests_in_dependency_order method
manifest_loader_project_hash: compute a SHA256-based project hash that includes environment factors and dependency hashes using ManifestLoader get_project_hash method
patch_loader_resource: patch the global loader to use ResourceLoader for loading manifests from a Python package namespace
